# ASA Lab

> ASA Lab is a digital laboratory for design and invention. It combines 3D modelling, virtual electronics, block programming, drawing and drafting, chess and Russian draughts. The primary scenario is creating personal projects, experimenting and finding solutions. Classes and assignments are an optional way to organize collaborative or educational work.

Canonical website: https://asa-lab.ru/
Primary language: Russian (ru-RU)
Source repository: https://github.com/spikeal8-maker/asa-lab

## Key facts

- Primary use: people create, investigate, test and improve their own digital projects.
- Collaboration: teachers, classes and assignments can organize shared or educational project work.
- Safety: no advertising, no open child chat with strangers, role- and class-scoped access.
- Product principle: unsupported or unverified results are diagnosed explicitly instead of being presented as successful.
- Tools: 3D modelling, virtual electronics, block programming, drawing and drafting, chess and Russian draughts.
- Brand spelling: ASA Lab. Russian alternate name: АСА Лаб.

## Crawler policy

Public product information may be indexed, summarized and cited with a link to the canonical page. ASA Lab does not grant permission through this file to use its content for model training. See https://asa-lab.ru/robots.txt for machine-readable crawler directives.
